name: Standardisation 1 Code
definition: Specifies whether the terms of the security (underlying instruments, expiration date, contract size) are defined according to the exchange specifications or whether they can be user defined.

FLEX.name: Flexible
FLEX.definition: Derivatives defined according to exchange specifications, but certain characteristics can be user defined.

NSTA.name: Non Standardised
NSTA.definition: Custom-made instrument between two parties. Underlying|instruments, expiration date and contract size of the derivatives are not standardised.

STAN.name: Standardised
STAN.definition: The underlying instruments, expiration date and contract size of the derivatives are standardised.
